description: Duivelseiland 1899-1900 speculative rows (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 50-72, Balthasar Floriszstraat 4-10 and 18-26): 5.2-5.7 m orange-red brick fronts of four storeys under a white timber cornice at 13.4 m over a 0.75 m brick corbel-table frieze; three equal axes of white T-windows (a top light over two casements) with white sills; flat heads on every storey; no balconettes; one white pediment dormer with a carved crest over the centre; the house door with its transom on an end axis

match.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62-68 and Balthasar Floriszstraat 18-24 on the 2024-12-11 strips (40 px/m, 1 m grid): white cornice top 13.35-13.5 m; 3DBAG eaves 15.2-15.8 m read the roof behind it (the dark roof face shows 13.5-14.2 m between the dormers), so the cornice is the type's front line (frontEavesM). BAG 1899-1900 on the exemplars; widths 5.2-5.7 m. The strip skyline reads 14.5-14.9 m on the clean-sky pands (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 50-70, Balthasar Floriszstraat 2A-8, 18, 32-34): the top of the dark roof face behind the cornice, between the dormers (frontSkylineM). A variant of the museum-de-1899-corbel-cornice row (same builder's front, the same storey lines, corbel table, cornice and dormers): the balconettes and the arch rings are the only differences, which the edges cannot tell apart reliably, so reviewed pands are pinned (duivelseiland-review-types.json)

pediment-dormer.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62-68: one white dormer 1.2-1.3 m wide over the centre axis, its body 13.5-14.6 m to a pediment with a carved crest to about 15.2 m (the crest is not drawn)

door-left.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 66, Balthasar Floriszstraat 24: the house door with a transom on the left axis, two windows

door-right.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 64 and 62, Balthasar Floriszstraat 18: mirrored, the door on the right axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey: three T-windows of one width (1.1-1.15 m); no balconettes
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; the door on the left or right axis
rhythm.groundFloor: residential: house door with a transom and two windows
rhythm.roofline: white timber cornice at 13.4 m over a brick corbel-table frieze; one white pediment dormer
